question: In which year did the British establish their base in Bombay?

question: What is the significance of the year 1911 in the context of colonial cities?

B) Founding of the Asiatic Society
C) Enactment of the Cornwallis Code
D) First screening of a film at Watson’s Hotel
answer: A) Transfer of capital from Calcutta to Delhi
explanation: The timeline records the transfer of the capital from Calcutta to Delhi as a key event in 1911.

answer_hi: A) कलकत्ता से दिल्ली राजधानी का स्थानांतरण

question:
Match the following European trading bases with their establishment years:
I. Panaji - 1510
II. Masulipatnam - 1605
III. Madras - 1639
IV. Bombay - 1661
options: A) I, II, III, IV are correct
B) I, II, III, and IV are all correct
C) II, III, IV are correct
D) I, III, IV are correct
answer: B) I, II, III, and IV are all correct
explanation: The provided timeline lists Panaji (1510), Masulipatnam (1605), Madras (1639), and Bombay (1661) correctly as per the historical records mentioned.
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित यूरोपीय व्यापारिक केंद्रों को उनके स्थापना वर्षों के साथ सुमेलित करें:
I. पणजी - 1510
II. मछलीपट्टनम - 1605
III. मद्रास - 1639
IV. बॉम्बे - 1661
options_hi: A) I, II, III, IV सही हैं
B) I, II, III, और IV सभी सही हैं
C) II, III, IV सही हैं
D) I, III, IV सही हैं
answer_hi: B) I, II, III, और IV सभी सही हैं
explanation_hi: दी गई समय-सीमा में पणजी (1510), मछलीपट्टनम (1605), मद्रास (1639), और बॉम्बे (1661) का उल्लेख ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार सही है।
